A dependency group that includes itself under a different spelling is reported as a cycle between two groups:

```python
from packaging.dependency_groups import resolve_dependency_groups
resolve_dependency_groups({"a": [{"include-group": "A"}]}, "a")
# ExceptionGroup ... CyclicDependencyGroup: Cyclic dependency group include while resolving a: A -> a, a -> A
```

"A" and "a" are the same group after name normalization, so this is a self-include and must be reported as one, with the normalized name: "... while resolving a: a includes itself". The same holds for {"a.b": [{"include-group": "A_B"}]} (normalized name a-b) and any other spelling that normalizes to the group's own name.
